title: Delay-Aware Reinforcement Learning for O-RAN Control under Stochastic Reward Feedback
abstract: arXiv:2611.19344v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) is increasingly employed for real-time control in Open Radio Access Networks (O-RANs). However, the asynchronous nature of O-RAN feedback introduces stochastic delays between actions and their observable rewards, leading to misaligned credit assignment and unstable training. This letter formulates the O-RAN control problem as a Markov decision process (MDP) with delayed and stochastic rewards, where the true reward corresponding to an action is received after an unknown delay. To address this, we propose a delay-aware deep RL framework that integrates a long short-term memory (LSTM)-based delay predictor and a temporal reward realignment module within an off-policy learning pipeline. translated_title: 随机奖励反馈下面向O-RAN控制的延迟感知强化学习
translated_abstract: 强化学习（RL）正日益被应用于开放无线接入网络的实时控制中。然而，O-RAN反馈的异步特性在动作与其可观测奖励之间引入了随机延迟，导致信用分配错位和训练不稳定。本文将O-RAN控制问题建模为具有延迟性和随机性奖励的马尔可夫决策过程（MDP），其中与某个动作对应的真实奖励会在未知延迟之后才被接收到。为解决这一问题，我们提出了一种延迟感知的深度强化学习框架，该框架在离策略学习流程中集成了基于长短期记忆网络的延迟预测器和时间奖励重对齐模块。利用从Open AI Cellular（OAIC）测试平台收集的真实延迟轨迹数据，我们证明了所提出的框架相比对照方法实现了更快的收敛速度，并显著减少了延迟违规和数据包丢��。
tldr: 该论文提出一种延迟感知的深度强化学习框架，通过LSTM延迟预测器与时间奖励重对齐模块解决O-RAN控制中随机奖励延迟导致的信用分配错位问题，实现了更快收敛并显著降低延迟违规与丢包。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a delay-aware deep RL framework that integrates an LSTM-based delay predictor and a temporal reward realignment module to address misaligned credit assignment caused by stochastic reward delays in O-RAN control, achieving faster convergence and significantly reducing latency violations and packet drops.
